title: rhexia mariana var. lanceolata
intro: Rhexia mariana var. lanceolata, commonly known as the Virginia marsh-crankweed, is a plant species in the family Melastomataceae. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Rhexia mariana var. lanceolata include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of the plant include soothing and calming effects, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
